name: peripherals
description: Five keyboards and five mice enumerate through the CH375B and produce correct normalized events. Every device is recorded with its VID/PID, descriptor hash, button count and the exact reason it passed or failed - including the ones that pass, because 'it worked' is not something anyone can act on later.
requires: U1 with CH375B and TXS0108E level shifter
PC1 and PC2 attached to the two USB device ports
5 USB keyboards of different vendors, at least one behind a built-in hub
5 USB mice of different vendors, at least one with 5 buttons and one with 3

steps.note: open the U1 CDC port and read DEVICE_INFO
every key or button the device has, once each
a detach must never leave a key held on either PC

checks.every_device_enumerated: each of the ten devices reached the ready state
checks.no_gap_over_50ms: no observed pause longer than 50 ms
checks.no_stuck_keys: every detach left both computers with nothing held
